checks: Progressive pressure stays bounded and HP at wave20 is less than legacy sponge growth
Procedural plans vary without early controllers or multiple mute auras
Clean waves award an extra bonus without a timer favoring fast weapons
A nonlethal P2 hit immediately classifies the attempt as coop
Real damage clears clean bonus and observes KO even after a leader swap
Wave 5 preserves wounds and KO, offers a stable draft and never grants the reward twice
Loading a partial wave rewinds unbanked rewards and preserves wounds, KO and selected upgrades
Card effects apply to real damage, health thresholds, guard, stun and resonance
Campaign resources return after an expedition instead of granting temporary supplies permanently
Legacy scores remain visible as history and never enter the new rankings
Pause freezes warnings, wave timers and combat time
Warning placement cannot be offscreen or hidden under HUD/control corners
Elite damage stays below one-shot range for the weakest selected maxHP
Respite every 5 waves heals the standing team or revives one member, once, and survives a reload
Rare respite raises the chosen card by two levels and the save keeps the budget
Enemies arrive in groups of 2 to 4 (5 in coop) on valid, separate spots
Coop follows the solo difficulty curve with a fixed extra (it no longer grows faster)
Everyone takes the same damage; heroes that survive less hit harder, P2 hits use P2 power
Draft every 2 waves (and on respite waves); other waves breathe and continue alone
22 cards in three rarities; instrument cards only with that hero; legendary is rarer
One reroll per attempt changes the offers; skipping banks points and starts the next wave
New card effects: drum shield, overdrive, crowd, chain, pierce, war drum, synth wave, Franco stun, encore
Every 10 waves a campaign boss echo leads half a wave; the wave ends only after it falls
Elite modifiers: shield blocks three hits, split leaves two echoes, frenetic recovers faster
Biomes change every 10 waves with a seeded obstacle layout; hazards wait in the Fenda
method: VM of real dungeon functions; combat and DOM dependencies stubbed. Not a human comfort/fun test.
